read.thesis: Teva's Q3 beat rests on AUSTEDO (up 38% to $601M) and the innovative franchise, but generics grew only 2% and the TAPI sale was pulled and restarted; no capacity signals.

triggers.label: AUSTEDO US sales up 38% to $601M
triggers.quote: The U.S. reached $601 million in Q3 '25, growing at 38% year-over-year. And this is the first time we have passed $600 million.

triggers.label: AUSTEDO 2025 guide raised $50-100M
triggers.quote: we are increasing our full year outlook for AUSTEDO by $50 million to $100 million to a new range of $2.05 billion to $2.15 billion
triggers.highlight: increasing our full year outlook for AUSTEDO

triggers.label: Generics FY25 flat in local currency
triggers.quote: we expect our global generics revenue for the full year to be flat in local currency compared to 2024
triggers.highlight: global generics revenue for the full year to be flat

triggers.label: Non-GAAP gross margin up 120bp to 55.3%
triggers.quote: Our non-GAAP gross margin increased by 120 basis points year-over-year to 55.3%.
triggers.highlight: increased by 120 basis points year-over-year to 55.3%

triggers.label: TAPI exclusive sale collapsed, process relaunched
triggers.quote: At this time, we have decided not to move forward with those discussions as we were unable to reach an agreement
triggers.highlight: decided not to move forward with those discussions

triggers.label: Free cash flow $515M vs $922M prior year
triggers.quote: Our free cash flow in Q3 was $515 million compared to $922 million in Q3 2024.

guidance.quote: we are increasing our full year outlook for AUSTEDO by $50 million to $100 million
we are tightening the full year guidance range to be between $16.8 billion and $17 billion
we expect our global generics revenue for the full year to be flat in local currency compared to 2024
Our free cash flow guidance range remains the same between $1.6 billion to $1.9 billion.
we confirm our guidance of $630 million to $640 million
we are on track to reach our net debt-to-EBITDA target of 2x by 2027
we are on track to our 30% margin
we can confirm with confidence our 2027 revenue target of $2.5 billion
These programs are expected to deliver approximately $700 million of net savings between 2025 and 2027
We continue to expect our operating expenses to be between 27% and 28% of revenue.
For Q4 2025, we expect the first development milestone to contribute $250 million to revenue
we're well on track to add another $400 million by 2027
the Q4 implied guidance of $55 million to $65 million provides a cleaner run rate

prior_guidance_check.quote: net debt-to-EBITDA of below 3x for the first time since Q3 2016

prior_guidance_check.metric: Transformation savings ~$70M in 2025, half achieved by Q3
prior_guidance_check.quote: approximately half of our planned savings of $70 million for 2025 already achieved by Q3
we're well on track to add another $400 million by 2027 as we forecasted back at the start of the year

red_flags.label: Q3 AUSTEDO boosted by favourable gross-to-net and prior-year channel stocking
red_flags.quote: in Q3 2024 and Q2 2024, there was some channel stocking with regard to AUSTEDO XR

red_flags.label: Q3 Revlimid volume pulled forward from Q2
red_flags.quote: leading to some volume shift from the second quarter to the third quarter

red_flags.label: One-time Medicaid adjustment depressed UZEDY Q3
red_flags.quote: revenue growth was partially impacted by a onetime Medicaid gross to net adjustment
